newsitem.title: USA: TWA May load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: TWA May load factor rises.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Friday its passenger load factor was 67.8 percent in May, up from 67.6 percent a year ago.
Because of planned reductions on some international routes, capacity, traffic and the number of passengers declined from May 1996, the airline said.
Revenue passenger miles for the month were 2.11 billion, down from 2.29 billion a year ago. Available seat miles were 3.11 billion, down from 3.39 billion a year ago.
Year-to-date through May, passenger load factor was 67.4 percent, up from 65.1 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles were 9.73 billion, down from 10.24 billion a year ago, and available seat miles were 14.43 billion, down from 15.72 billion a year ago.
TWA shares were up 1-1/16 at 10-1/8 Friday.
